description: Source code for the AppDelegate class managing application lifecycle, server process, resource copying, and UI interactions in a macOS application.

classes.name: AppDelegate
classes.description: Main application delegate handling startup, shutdown, resource management, server process control, and UI interactions.

methods.name: applicationDidFinishLaunching
methods.description: Initializes resources, starts server, and posts server started notification.

methods.name: applicationShouldHandleReopen
methods.description: Handles application reopen event, opening a new window if no windows are visible.

methods.name: applicationWillTerminate
methods.description: Stops the server process during application termination.

methods.name: openNewWindow
methods.description: Creates and shows a new main window.

methods.name: showWhatsNewDialogIfNeeded
methods.description: Displays 'What's New' dialog if the version has been updated.

methods.name: getCloudServer
methods.description: Opens URL to get cloud server setup.

methods.name: webFolder
methods.description: Returns URL for application's web server folder.

methods.name: copyResources
methods.description: Copies resource files to application support directory.

methods.name: copyResource
methods.description: Copies individual resource files from bundle to destination.

methods.name: generateSessionToken
methods.description: Generates a random session token string.

methods.name: getFreePort
methods.description: Finds a free network port for server.

methods.name: startServer
methods.description: Starts the focalboard server process with appropriate arguments and environment.

methods.name: stopServer
methods.description: Terminates the server process if running.
